    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is prepended, after a single space, to the lastName to compose
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string

          title: First name

          title: Last name

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized the same way (trimmed,
            whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When supplied it is normalized and appended, after a single space, to the composed
            'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred
            when present. Returned as the normalized composed address — the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). On create a national number is accepted and
            normalized (assuming country code '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region, fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. When omitted on creation it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it determines the
            owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and postcode (they are the same household); it bypasses the household
            duplicate block and creates the owner as a declared household member, which is never
            flagged as a possible duplicate. The householdId is deterministic and shared regardless
            of this flag. Write-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:

        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

            salutation:

            displayName:

              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans — the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first eight upper-cased hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName.
                Assigned at creation; there is no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits contained
                in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 6
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier for the owner's household — the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode. Every owner has one,
                so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: A derived descriptive key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                where email is empty when absent. It embeds the deterministic householdId; duplicate
                detection is keyed on the household (last name and postcode), so creating an owner in a
                household that already exists is rejected with 409 unless 'sharesHousehold' is set.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year, assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0, and gains
                2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3 or more,
                and 3 for a tenure of more than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived at creation from membershipPoints
                as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the owner's region-and-hash identity — the
                REGION prefix of the customerCode, derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to a
                fixed city-to-region table, Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when neither the postcode nor the city maps to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality, taken from a fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel for the owner, derived at read time.
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate measured
                against registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the same business day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when, at the moment this owner was created, an existing owner
                shared this owner's last name and postcode but had a different telephone; the
                owner is still created (it is not a household duplicate). Always false for an owner
                created as a declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true). False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:

              description: The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of,
                set only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:

              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false.

                duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is prepended, after a single space, to the lastName to compose
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized the same way (trimmed,
            whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When supplied it is normalized and appended, after a single space, to the composed
            'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred
            when present. Returned as the normalized composed address — the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). On create a national number is accepted and
            normalized (assuming country code '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region, fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. When omitted on creation it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it determines the
            owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and postcode (they are the same household); it bypasses the household
            duplicate block and creates the owner as a declared household member, which is never
            flagged as a possible duplicate. The householdId is deterministic and shared regardless
            of this flag. Write-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and lastName, space-separated (e.g. 'DR who'),
                or just the lastName when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans — the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first eight upper-cased hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName.
                Assigned at creation; there is no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits contained
                in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 6
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier for the owner's household — the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode. Every owner has one,
                so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: A derived descriptive key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                where email is empty when absent. It embeds the deterministic householdId; duplicate
                detection is keyed on the household (last name and postcode), so creating an owner in a
                household that already exists is rejected with 409 unless 'sharesHousehold' is set.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year (1 July basis) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June and is labelled by the last two
                digits of the calendar year in which it ends (a date on or after 1 July belongs to
                the fiscal year ending the following calendar year).
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0, and gains
                2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3 or more,
                and 3 for a tenure of more than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived at creation from membershipPoints
                as 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the owner's region-and-hash identity — the
                REGION prefix of the customerCode, derived from the owner's postcode (falling back to a
                fixed city-to-region table, Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when neither the postcode nor the city maps to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality, taken from a fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel for the owner, derived at read time.
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate measured
                against registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.

## Summary

I moved every registration-date–derived value onto a **fiscal-year basis** (fiscal year = 1 July → 30 June, labelled by the calendar year it *ends* in, so `2026-09-04 → FY27`).

**New helper** — `rest/function/owner/FiscalYear.java`:
- `endingYear(date)` — the calendar year the fiscal year ends in (month ≥ July → year+1).
- `label(date)` — the `FY<YY>` string (null-safe).
- `elapsedBetween(from, to)` — whole fiscal years elapsed (count of 1 July boundaries crossed).

**Behaviour changes (per spec):**
1. **`fiscalYear` response field** — added to the `Owner` schema in `openapi.yml` and wired into `OwnerMapper` as a read-time computed mapping `FiscalYear.label(owner.getRegistrationDate())`, so `GET /api/owners/{id}` now returns `"fiscalYear": "FY27"`.
2. **Membership identifier year segment** — `AssignMembershipNumber` now uses the fiscal-year two digits instead of the calendar year (`…-M27` rather than `…-M26` for a September 2026 date).
3. **Tenure** — `AssignMembershipLevel` now scores its 3 points when tenure exceeds **one elapsed fiscal year** (`FiscalYear.elapsedBetween`), replacing the old strict 365-day window.

I also updated the OpenAPI descriptions for `membershipNumber`, `membershipPoints`, and the JavaDoc on the two functions to match.

**Convention note:** the spec fixes the 1 July start and the `FY<YY>` format but not whether `YY` is the starting or ending year. I chose the dominant convention (label = ending year), which the `FY\d{2}` test accepts either way; both the `fiscalYear` field and the membership number derive from the same `FiscalYear.endingYear`, so they stay consistent. The audit log confirmed `registrationDate=2026-09-04 → membershipNumber=…-M27`.
